chunks: Everything in this book that is narrated from Dawud al-Raqqi has been transmitted by me from al-Husayn ibn Ahmad ibn Idris—may Allah be pleased with him—from his father, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abdullah ibn Ahmad al-Razi, from Hariz ibn Salih, from Isma'il ibn Mihran, from Zakariyya ibn Adam, from Dawud ibn Kathir al-Raqqi.
And it has been narrated from al-Sadiq عليه السلام that he said: “Place Dawud al-Raqqi in relation to me in the position of al-Miqdad in relation to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله.”

key_terms.الصَّادِقِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام, from whom the praise is narrated
key_terms.بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْمِقْدَادِ: in the rank or station of al-Miqdad; a comparison expressing high closeness and esteem
key_terms.دَاوُدَ الرَّقِّيَّ: Dawud al-Raqqi, the transmitter being identified and praised in this report
key_terms.رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, the point of comparison in the narration

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Dawud al-Raqqi in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih, and how did al-Sadiq عليه السلام describe him?
ai.summary: This passage provides the sanad/isnad for narrations transmitted from Dawud al-Raqqi in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. It also preserves a statement from al-Sadiq عليه السلام praising Dawud al-Raqqi by comparing his rank with the Imam to that of al-Miqdad with the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله.
